messages:
nico: quick thread to align on multi-cloud onboarding for Acme: they want Azure private offer, GCP marketplace listing, and AWS SaaS Marketplace registration. coordinating legal, ops, and SI (system integrator) integration points. can we list what each cloud needs?

tara: breaking down by cloud: Azure private: offer alias + manifest + webhook + publisher tenant. GCP: marketplace listing container image + GCS manifest + billing account mapping. AWS SaaS: SaaS-Boost or AMI? for us it's SaaS (API proxy) so need listing JSON, entitlement mapping, and contract SKU.

ben: SI ask: Acme's SI (DeltaSys) will provide SSO integration (SAML) and wants a joint runbook for incident handoff. we should include a short contact matrix and escalation P0/P1 steps in the partner docs.

legal-ops: legal: require single EULA delta covering cross-cloud terms + per-cloud privacy disclosure. for private offers we need termination clause and refund language. will prepare a 1-paragraph template for marketplace pages. also flag: export control checks for GCP region choices.

partner-onboarding-bot: checklist links: https://internal.re/pm/marketplace/multi-cloud-playbook and templates at s3://redwood-marketplace/templates/multi-cloud-manifest.txt

nico: ops question: for AWS SaaS we'll rely on metering events. do we want marketplace to bill, or use our own subscription mapping (partner-managed)?

tara: recommendation: let each marketplace handle consumption metering for launch (simpler), and we'll ingest consumption events into our billing/analytics pipeline. convert to partner-managed invoicing later if requested. ensure signature validation and replay protection.

ben: SI integration items: provide SAML metadata endpoint, OIDC redirect URIs (if applicable), and a small SDK snippet for DeltaSys to call Redwood's onboarding API. include sample terraform for role creation.

nico: can someone paste a tiny manifest example we can give Acme & DeltaSys? minimal, per-cloud agnostic.

tara: paste below — send as sample only:
```json
{"product":"redwood-inference","plans":[{"id":"trial-30d","displayName":"30 Day Trial","limits":{"tokens_per_month":75000}}],"support":"partners@redwood.ai","runbook":"s3://redwood-marketplace/onboarding/runbooks/acme-runbook-v1.md"}
```

legal-ops: user-facing blurb draft: "Try Redwood Inference across Azure, GCP, and AWS via our private trial offer. 30-day access with a 75k token monthly cap. By enrolling, customers accept Redwood's Marketplace Terms and Privacy Policy. We collect usage metadata (no raw content)." will post to drive for review.

nico: ops action items: tara = create per-cloud manifest copies and stub webhooks by EOD, ben = assemble SI runbook and SAML metadata, legal-ops = finalize marketplace paragraph and EULA delta. I'll coordinate announcement timing with partners (private-first, public after conversion window).

ben: DeltaSys asked about joint announcement PR timeline. recommend private offer + SI onboarding for 2 weeks then joint PR. I'll draft a proposed timeline and share with partner.

nico: perfect — schedule partner handoff 10am PT tomorrow. dropping a short one-pager after the call. :white_check_mark:
